detailedSteps.subject: author
detailedSteps.sentence: Model author writes the model in Live editor.
detailedSteps.about: The author writes or edits a Lines file.
detailedSteps.caption: The author writes or edits a Lines file.

detailedSteps.subject: editor
detailedSteps.sentence: Live editor sends model text to Model semantics.
detailedSteps.about: The live editor checks each change. If it finds errors, the last good diagram stays visible.
detailedSteps.caption: The live editor checks each change. If it finds errors, the last good diagram stays visible.

detailedSteps.subject: semantics
detailedSteps.sentence: Model semantics checks the text with Lines language.
detailedSteps.about: The language parses text into a canonical model and reports errors with their line and column.
detailedSteps.caption: The language parses text into a canonical model and reports errors with their line and column.

detailedSteps.subject: lines
detailedSteps.sentence: Lines language returns the parsed model to Model semantics.
detailedSteps.about: Model semantics resolves nesting, views, audience wording and scenarios.
detailedSteps.caption: Model semantics resolves nesting, views, audience wording and scenarios.

detailedSteps.subject: semantics
detailedSteps.sentence: Model semantics supplies the resolved picture to Layout engine.
detailedSteps.about: The viewer asks layout to place the resolved picture. Space is reserved for every audience.
detailedSteps.caption: The viewer asks layout to place the resolved picture. Space is reserved for every audience.

detailedSteps.subject: layout
detailedSteps.sentence: Layout engine supplies positioned boxes to Signal renderer.
detailedSteps.about: Signal uses the positions to draw SVG boxes, connections and labels.
detailedSteps.caption: Signal uses the positions to draw SVG boxes, connections and labels.

detailedSteps.subject: renderer
detailedSteps.sentence: Signal renderer supplies the drawing to Browser viewer.
detailedSteps.about: The browser viewer displays the drawing and manages reader actions.
detailedSteps.caption: The browser viewer displays the drawing and manages reader actions.

detailedSteps.subject: viewer
detailedSteps.sentence: Browser viewer shows the diagram to Diagram reader.
detailedSteps.about: The reader explores the picture and can share a link to the same view and state.
detailedSteps.caption: The reader explores the picture and can share a link to the same view and state.

components.name: Model author
components.about: Writes the architecture once in a Lines file.
outgoing: Model author writes the model in Live editor.

components.name: Live editor
components.about: Loads a model or checks edits beside the diagram.
incoming: Model author writes the model in Live editor.
outgoing: Live editor sends model text to Model semantics.

components.name: Language and semantics
components.about: Checks the text and resolves the parts, views and wording.
components.technicalNote: The language parser produces a canonical model and diagnostics. Model semantics resolves containment, view selection, audience wording and scenario steps independently of layout. These modules are pure TypeScript and are shared by the browser and command-line workflows.

components.name: Lines language
components.tagline: Parse the text and report errors
incoming: Model semantics checks the text with Lines language.
outgoing: Lines language returns the parsed model to Model semantics.

components.name: Model semantics
incoming: Live editor sends model text to Model semantics.
Lines language returns the parsed model to Model semantics.
outgoing: Model semantics checks the text with Lines language.
Model semantics supplies the resolved picture to Layout engine.

components.name: Layout, rendering and viewer
components.about: Places the diagram, draws it and responds to reader actions.
components.technicalNote: Layout reserves space for every declared audience before positioning boxes and connections. The Signal renderer consumes those positions and draws SVG. The browser viewer manages navigation and reader actions. Changing audience wording preserves the diagram geometry.

components.name: Layout engine
incoming: Model semantics supplies the resolved picture to Layout engine.
outgoing: Layout engine supplies positioned boxes to Signal renderer.

components.name: Signal renderer
incoming: Layout engine supplies positioned boxes to Signal renderer.
outgoing: Signal renderer supplies the drawing to Browser viewer.

components.name: Browser viewer
incoming: Signal renderer supplies the drawing to Browser viewer.
outgoing: Browser viewer shows the diagram to Diagram reader.

components.name: Diagram reader
components.about: Reads the diagram, changes wording, opens parts and follows scenarios.
incoming: Browser viewer shows the diagram to Diagram reader.
